description: ⚡️The protective armor that allows us to bare-hand 765,000 Volts⚡️The Faraday suit, invented in the 1930s, is made of conductive metal threads—usually stainless steel or silver-coated nylon. It works by forming a shield that lets current flow around the body instead of through it — so the suit doesn’t stop the voltage, it makes you part of it. This allows High Voltage Aviation lineman like @Coltyn lane to safely work energized lines.#bluecollar #trades #helicopter
